title: Higher-Degree SEL Computation Gadgets
summary: SEL computation gadgets are known only for nonlinear monomial degrees two and three; constructing higher-degree instantiations remains open.

formal_statement.body: Construct computation gadgets for the SEL nonlinear masking scheme when its decoding function is the sum of one nonlinear monomial of degree $d$ and $\ell$ linear shares, where $\ell\in\mathbb{Z}_{>0}$ and $d>3$. Existing SEL gadgets cover only $d=2$ and $d=3$, leaving higher-degree instantiations unresolved.

scope.domain: Computation-gadget design for the SEL nonlinear masking scheme in symmetric cryptography.
parameters: d: degree of the nonlinear monomial, with the unresolved range greater than three
ℓ: positive number of linear shares
scope.unresolved_remainder: Construct SEL computation gadgets for nonlinear monomial degrees greater than three.

citations.label: Haystack ciphers : White-box countermeasures as Symmetric encryption

progress.summary: The source states that existing SEL work provides gadgets only for degrees two and three and explicitly calls higher-degree instantiation an open problem. Its general analysis does not involve gadgets.
